article_trial_or_failure_notes: unsuccessful in synthesizing an Yb analogue isostructural to Ln2(TP)3(H2O)4
mof_description: an ytterbium metal-organic framework built by organic linker terephthalic acid
modification_notes: text: "We were also unsuccessful in synthesizing an Yb-counterpart isostructural to 1, 2 or any of the reported Ln2(TP)3(H2O)4 derivatives..." Apply the same Nd2(TP)3(H2O)4 protocol but swap Nd2O3 to Yb2O3.
rationale: Authors report failure to obtain Yb2(TP)3(H2O)4 under the Ln2(TP)3(H2O)4 protocol. We encode that negative by swapping Nd/Er to Yb2O3 under identical conditions. No other explicit failed conditions for Yb2(TP)3(H2O)2/6/8.H2O syntheses were described.
vessel_type: Teflon-lined Parr acid digestion vessel (Model 4744; 45 mL)

article_trial_or_failure_notes: Hydrothermal CAU-17 synthesis at 120 °C for 24 h (reported method) did not reproducibly yield equivalent rod-shaped crystals.
mof_description: a bismuth metal-organic framework built by organic linker benzene-1,3,5-tricarboxylic acid
modification_notes: Failures/evidence: (i) Hydrothermal 120 °C for 24 h gave lower yield and ‘did not generate equivalent rod-shaped crystals’ (text; Fig. S4). (ii) DMF + NaOAc with ultrasound produced Ellipsoids (poorly crystalline, non-porous) and agitation yielded Almond-flakes, not rods (Sections 2.2, 3.1–3.2; Fig. S3).
rationale: Target CAU-17 rods. Reported hydrothermal 120 °C/24 h gave non-reproducible rod-shaped crystals and lower yield; DMF + NaOAc under ultrasound formed non-porous Ellipsoids/Almond-flakes instead of CAU-17.
stirring: ultrasonic bath to dissolve; then static (no agitation)

article_trial_or_failure_notes: CuCl2 gave no crystalline Cu–vanadate/diphosphonate; vanadate failed to incorporate in 3
mof_description: a copper metal-organic framework built by organic linkers 1,2-ethylenediphosphonic acid and methylene diphosphonic acid
modification_notes: Evidence: text: “When copper(II) chloride was used as a starting material, no crystalline copper–vanadate or copper-diphosphonate phases were observed…” (Sec. 3.1). Also: text: “When the reaction was carried out at 200 °C using ethylene diphosphonic acid… the vanadate failed to incorporate and 3 was isolated.”
rationale: Negative conditions focus on explicit failures: CuCl2·2H2O thwarted crystallization of copper–vanadate/diphosphonate phases; using ethylenediphosphonic acid at 200 °C yielded vanadate-free [Cu2(bpyr)(H2O)2(HO3PCH2CH2PO3H)2] (3) instead of vanadate frameworks (1) or (2). Plans are based on syntheses of 1, 2, and 3.

article_trial_or_failure_notes: Replacing 1,4-H2bdc with 3,5-H2pdc did not yield the intended 3D structure; different 2D MOFs obtained.
mof_description: a terbium metal-organic framework with Tb(III) 6-connected nodes; 8-coordinate (TDD) built by organic linkers 3,5-pyridinedicarboxylic acid and 1,2-benzenedicarboxylic acid
modification_notes: Evidence: text states replacing 1,4-H2bdc with 3,5-H2pdc did not give the intended 3D structure (“we haven’t got the structure in mind”), yielding 2D MOF-3/MOF-4 instead; same temperature used; see Fig. 5.
rationale: Replacing 1,4-H2bdc with 3,5-H2pdc under the MOF-1 hydrothermal protocol yielded different 2D Tb-MOFs (MOF-3/MOF-4) instead of the targeted 3D MOF-1-type network. We record these as negative linker swaps under otherwise identical conditions.
solvent_main_amount_text: 5 mL added, plus 5.00 mL metal aqueous solution

article_trial_or_failure_notes: Fe(III) attempt with Fe2(SO4)3 still yielded compound 3
mof_description: an iron metal-organic framework with two 6-connected Fe nodes; μ6-5-phenoxonicotinato bridges built by organic linker 5-hydroxynicotinic acid

mof_description: an iron metal-organic framework with a-Mo8O26 clusters linked by {Co2(tpyprz)(H2O)2}4+ into 2D layers built by organic linker tetra-2-pyridylpyrazine
modification_notes: Direct failure: text states “attempts to prepare an analogous iron compound yielded only [Fe(tpyprz)2]2[Mo8O26]·3.7H2O” (Ref. 23). We therefore swap Co→Fe under the same hydrothermal recipe (170 °C, H2O, HF).
rationale: Paper reports that Fe under analogous conditions gives molecular [Fe(tpyprz)2]2[Mo8O26]·3.7H2O rather than the 2D frameworks [M2(tpyprz)(H2O)2Mo8O26] or [{Cu2(tpyprz)}2Mo8O26]. We encode Fe swaps of the Co and Ni protocols as negative conditions.
metal_cluster_connectivity: a-Mo8O26 clusters linked by {Co2(tpyprz)(H2O)2}4+ into 2D layers
